patterns.note: Sections alternate between a deep forest green and a warm off-white background, creating clear visual separation and a strong color-blocked rhythm.
Headings and most body text utilize a monospace font, creating a distinctive, structured, and slightly technical feel, while maintaining readability through size and weight variations.
A vibrant, almost neon orange is used exclusively for calls-to-action and key interactive elements, providing a high-contrast accent against the dominant dark green and off-white palette.
The main navigation bar transitions from being integrated into the hero section to a fixed, sticky element at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, maintaining its dark background.
Content is frequently presented in a grid of image-based cards with concise text overlays or accompanying descriptions, used for features, events, and practical information.

technique_notes: The hero section features a looping background video that plays automatically, with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability. The main navigation bar is implemented to become sticky at the top of the screen after the initial scroll, maintaining its dark background.
Content sections are visually separated by alternating full-width background colors (a deep forest green and a warm off-white), creating a strong visual rhythm down the page.
Information is presented in a flexible grid of image-based cards, each with a clear heading and a short descriptive paragraph, often with a call-to-action button.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase headings (~3x body) provide strong hierarchy, while body text is clear and readable, all within a monospace family.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle — buttons and image corners have a slight rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical padding between full-width sections and a consistent internal rhythm for content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich forest green as the primary brand color, paired with a warm off-white and a vibrant orange accent, creates a sophisticated yet energetic feel. The consistent application of a monospace font for both headings and body text, while maintaining excellent readability, is a unique and memorable design choice that sets it apart.
